subject: proj-dy
title: PROJ.DY.------PR.INT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 469 (MP(I)-43). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the subject; PR-INT (primary intention) is the partner. From the subject: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics), OBS (observation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From SPT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From OBS: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From T-C-IMP: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From AFI: PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies). From INFO-DY: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From RT-DY: MOT-DY.
